abort.not_loaded: COMEXIO Local is not currently loaded.
abort.no_sources: No light or cover sources found.
abort.manual_required: No automatic changes. The indicated rebuild must first be prepared manually in COMEXIO.
abort.repair_failed: Repair stopped. Check COMEXIO state and generate a new preview before retrying.
abort.repair_completed: Missing push resources created. Test the source with its physical switch.
abort.classification_saved: Classification saved. HA integration reload initiated.
abort.classification_conflict: An entity with the target type already exists. Nothing changed.
abort.sync_changed: COMEXIO or HA discovery changed; redo the preview.
abort.sync_completed: COMEXIO catalog synchronized to Home Assistant.
abort.sync_type_change: A device type changed. Use manual classification first.
abort.rebuild_failed: Rebuild could not start or resume.
abort.rebuild_cleanup_required: Rebuild prepared. Remove old managed push plans and Web-IO class, then resume from progress view.
abort.no_inputs: No supported physical I/AI inputs discovered.
abort.input_started: Input push job started. Check progress under Push & Inputs → Input push job status or in the diagnostic sensor.
abort.input_failed: Input push stopped: {reason}. Check partial changes before a new preview.
abort.input_completed: Input push is configured. Test the selected inputs and EnOcean values with real events.
abort.input_status_closed: Status view closed. Input push job was not modified.
